title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements — Deposit Acceptance Conditions
content:
These are the conditions on which the store accepts a deposit on a deal under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**.

1. **Deal status.** A deposit is accepted only on a deal in reserved or contracted status, as shown by the deal's own record.
2. **First deposit.** The first deposit on a deal must be at least the deal type's smallest reservation deposit.
3. **Total held.** The total of all deposits received on the deal, including the new one, may not exceed the deal type's largest total deposit.
4. **Method.** Only the payment methods listed for the deal type are accepted.
5. **Credit card deposits.** Credit card deposits on one deal may not total more than the deal type's credit card deposit maximum.
6. **Credit card money on the deal.** All credit card money on the deal, including the new deposit, may not exceed the deal type's credit card cap for the deal. This counts deposits received and payments posted by credit card on that deal, less any of them returned or refunded.
7. **Certified-funds period.** During the certified-funds period that follows a returned payment, only cash, cashier's check or debit card deposits are accepted.
8. **Whole refusal.** A deposit that would break any of these limits is refused as a whole. The store does not substitute a smaller amount on its own.

## Condition check (hypothetical deal type with a 5000.00 deposit maximum, a 3000.00 credit card deposit maximum and a 5000.00 credit card cap for the deal)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 4200.00 already received, new 900.00 deposit by cash | refused as a whole (total 5100.00 exceeds 5000.00) |
| 4200.00 already received, new 800.00 deposit by cash | accepted on the total (exactly 5000.00) |
| 2600.00 already by credit card, new 500.00 by credit card | refused as a whole (card deposits 3100.00 exceed 3000.00) |
| deal in delivered status | refused (status is not reserved or contracted) |
| new check deposit during a certified-funds period | refused (only cash, cashier's check or debit card) |
